notes: Page 92 verified. Roman Princess Nesahit disguised as monk: chanting David’s Psalms like angels, reading Pauline epistles, Acts, and Gospel of John at altar with unveiled face shining with blinding light, counseling against worldly snares, identified by Roman elder monk as royal daughter, searched for 12 years by emperor father’s envoys, resting in peace on this day.
